title: Looker Failures by Dashboard
app: Looker System Activity via DB Connect/API; Looker instance logs via UF; plan and query events via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:system_activity source="history" status="error"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dashboard_title
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Looker failures grouped by dashboard so operators immediately see which specific dashboards are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Looker is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Looker failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical dashboards.
visualization: Table of dashboard by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Looker are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
